Maple Test Labs — Reporting Co-op

Maple Test Labs is a fictional company created for regression tests. The role
supports a reporting team by reviewing spreadsheet inputs, writing basic SQL,
and preparing weekly charts from synthetic operational data.

Location: Waterloo, Ontario. Work mode: On-site.
This is a 4-month internship from January 4 to April 30, 2027.
Application deadline: October 20, 2026.

Students should be available for the complete stated placement. Experience with
Excel or a classroom data project is helpful. Nothing in this fixture represents
a live vacancy, a real deadline, or a real employer's eligibility requirements.
